meta.name: CCNL CED, ICT, Professioni Digitali e STP (Assoced-UGL)

family.reason: Data-processing and payroll service centres (CED) working for businesses.

notes.text: Salary model: paga base nazionale conglobata (Art. 172, 2022 stesura). Single TimeSeries per level, no separate contingenza or EDR.
Unified classification covers CED, ICT, Professioni Digitali and STP workers (Art. 172 + Tabella A, one scale). No separate STP salary table exists in the 2022 stesura or 2025 renewal.
Divisore convenzionale 173 h/month (Art. 171) and 26 d/month (Art. 170). Source: 2022 stesura fondoeasi.it.
Mensilita supplementari: tredicesima (Art. 175) and quattordicesima (Art. 176). additional_months = 14.
Indennita di funzione (Tabella A note, 2025 renewal): QDIR 287/296/306 EUR, Q 250/258/266 EUR per 14 mensilita. Tranche dates: 01/09/2025, 01/09/2026, 01/09/2027, distinct from base salary tranches.

Apprenticeship (Art. 23-24, 2022 stesura, ccnlced.it allegato): under_classification. First half 2 levels below, second half 1 level below. Level 5 exception: stays at Level 6 throughout 24-month track. Destination L2 duration 36 months (studiocerbone.com: 240 h/36 months for 2° livello). Source ccnlced.it showed '6 months' for L2 — treated as parsing artifact; 36 months adopted from studiocerbone.com.

Salary tranches: 01/09/2025 (source-confirmed, redigo.info and kitech.it), 01/06/2026 (source-confirmed, both sources agree), 01/03/2027 (redigo.info only, single-source), 01/01/2028 (redigo.info only, single-source).

layer_2 partial: apprenticeship tracks cover destinations 2, 3S, 3, 4, 5 only (Art. 22). Levels 1, Q, QDIR are excluded from apprenticeship by the contract text. Level 6 is used as the pay level for L5-destination apprentices but is not itself a destination.

Title XXIII: the daily meal benefit (Art. 179) is valued only when the caller supplies verified eligible days; the caller must check the absence of a canteen and a lunch break or split shift. Only caller-confirmed electronic vouchers are posted as exempt welfare; paper vouchers (different tax limits) remain unmodelled. The municipal public-transport subscription cost (Art. 180) and the episodic custody or transport of valuables above EUR 250 (Art. 181) remain unmodelled. Art. 177 was a conditional April 2025 one-off payment, not a Title XXIII allowance; it was repealed from September 2025.

limitation.remediation: For paper meal vouchers establish taxable value and treatment. For Art. 180 supply the actual municipal-only monthly public-transport subscription cost and verify the employer's limited-traffic-zone address. For Art. 181 supply each non-continuous custody/transport assignment and delivered value above EUR 250; establish its wage and TFR treatment before posting. Do not recur the repealed Art. 177 April 2025 one-off.

notes.text: INPS terziario rates reused from 2026-terziario.json (same sector as H016). Verify against annual INPS circular for exact H601 sub-sector rate.

limitation.remediation: Verify the H601 sub-sector INPS rate against the annual INPS circular.

notes.text: SCATTI (Art. 166, stesura 9 March 2022, p. 106): abrogated from 1 January 2019, they keep maturing for the staff in service on 31 December 2018: five biennial increments from the hire date, QDIR 52, Q 47, 1° 44, 2° 40, 3°S 36, 3° 33, 4° 30, 5° 27, 6° 24 EUR (parameters.seniority_increments.hired_until).

Art. 157 (p. 102) covers holidays during compulsory and optional absence. A Sunday holiday is paid by its own quota rather than topped up; 4 October, introduced after this text, remains excluded. Optional leave without an INPS indemnity is not topped up.

limitation.remediation: Resolve the Sunday holiday's separate quota and whether 4 October and unindemnified optional leave qualify.

notes.text: Art. 147 prints 75% (cento per cento) for ordinary injury integration after the waiting period. The numerical 75% is encoded; the contradictory words could indicate a 100% intended rate. Confirm with the signatories before using this target as definitive.

limitation.remediation: Obtain an authoritative clarification of the conflicting percentage in Art. 147.

notes.text: PERMITS (Art. 119, stesura 9 March 2022, p. 86): 32 hours for the abolished holidays and 56 of ROL, 72 in the firms with more than 15 employees (authentic interpretation: 88 and 104 hours in all); for the workers hired after 9 March 2022 the ROL are 50% after two years and 100% after four (the norma transitoria keeps 104 hours for the staff in service before); a twelfth per whole month of service; not taken within the year paid with the retribuzione di fatto at the deadline or taken by 30 June of the next year, as the employer states (EmployerProfile.permit_carryover).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, Professioni Digitali e STP, 9 March 2022

location.quote: Le indennità previste dal presente titolo saranno attribuite, caso per caso secondo le occorrenze, in tutti i CED che occupino più di 10 dipendenti, inclusi gli apprendisti. [...] I lavoratori in malattia, infortunio, ferie, permesso, recupero, aspettativa, maternità, sospensione disciplinare non hanno diritto a percepire le indennità. [...] una indennità sostitutiva del servizio mensa, cd. “ticket restaurant” pari a 6,00 Euro giornalieri.

provenance.transformation: EUR 6 per caller-verified eligible day from 1 April 2022; the posting supports only electronic vouchers at or below the applicable exemption, not paper vouchers. No monthly fixed allowance or entitlement on excluded absence days.

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, Digital Professions and STP, 28 July 2025

location.section: Art. 179 (modified); Art. 273 (p. 50)
location.quote: I CED Le aziende che applicano il presente CCNL, con più di 10 dipendenti, che non abbiano attivato il servizio mensa erogheranno ai dipendenti, il cui orario di lavoro preveda la pausa pranzo ovvero una prestazione lavorativa suddivisa in due parti, una indennità sostitutiva del servizio mensa, cd. “ticket restaurant” pari a 8,00 euro giornalieri, da riconoscersi anche in caso di svolgimento di lavoro in modalità di Smart-Working.

provenance.transformation: EUR 8 per caller-verified eligible day from the renewal's 1 September 2025 effective date, including eligible smart-working days. The posting supports only electronic vouchers at or below the applicable exemption, not paper vouchers. Old and new opening words appear together in the revision text; only the new wording applies.

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, Professioni Digitali e STP, stesura 9 marzo 2022 (Fondo EASI)

location.section: Art. 166 Scatti di anzianità
location.quote: L'istituto degli scatti di anzianità è abrogato a decorrere dal 1° Gennaio 2019. La normativa sulla maturazione degli scatti di anzianità, disciplinata nel presente articolo, continuerà viceversa ad essere applicata esclusivamente per il personale in forza al 31-12-2018. [...] Per l'anzianità di servizio maturata presso la stessa azienda il personale ha diritto a cinque scatti biennali. Ai fini della maturazione degli scatti, l'anzianità di servizio decorre dalla data di assunzione. [...] Quadri di Direzione 52.00 €; Quadri 47.00 €; 1 livello 44.00 €; 2 livello 40.00 €; 3 livello Super 36.00 €; 3 livello 33.00 €; 4 livello 30.00 €; 5 livello 27.00 €; 6 livello 24.00 €

provenance.transformation: Five biennial increments from the hire date at the amounts of the level, matured only by the staff in service on 31 December 2018 (hired_until); a worker hired later has none. The article covers 'il personale' at the amounts of each 'livello di inquadramento': an apprentice in service on 31 December 2018 takes those of the level he is classified at.

location.section: Malattia — integrazione al 100% per 180 giorni (settore ICT/terziario)

provenance.transformation: Comporto of several illnesses (2026-11-01): the comporto of 180 days counts the sick days of every episode of the calendar year. Source: https://www.ccnlced.it/ccnl-ced-ict-professioni-digitali-stp/ccnlced-ict-professioni-digitali-stp/stesura-ccnl-ced,-imprese-ict,-professioni-digitali-e-s.t.p.-del-09-marzo-2022.pdf, p. 96 (sha256 1ee460e786c76ced31b09153adf30a99ccb59c8587b4080b5cfb7045d150661e): 'per un periodo massimo di comporto pari a 180 giorni in un anno solare, calcolato per sommatoria di eventi conglobando all’interno del suddetto periodo sia gli eventi di malattia che gli eventi di infortunio'

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, professioni digitali e STP, stesura 9 marzo 2022

location.section: Art. 149 - Festività nel periodo di malattia o infortunio
location.quote: Ai sensi della L. 31 marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di malattia o infortunio, il lavoratore ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico rispettivamente dell'INPS e dell'INAIL, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro, in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 168.

provenance.transformation: On a national holiday (not a Sunday) falling in a sickness within the comporto, the integration target of the day is 100% of the daily pay, the INPS share of the day netted (sickness_rules.holiday). The injury holiday target nets the INAIL indemnity and ordinary daily integration. The national calendar adds 4 October from 2026 (L. 151/2025), which this text, signed before, does not list: excluded (excluded_days 10-04). The stated local patron saint day is covered on weekdays.

location.section: Art. 157
location.quote: Ai sensi della L. 1° marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di assenza obbligatoria e facoltativa, la lavoratrice ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico dell'INPS, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 170.

provenance.transformation: Top up weekday national holidays during compulsory maternity leave to 100% of daily pay, net of INPS and ordinary CCNL integration; no ordinary maternity integration is inferred. Paternity and optional leave are not handled by this rule.

location.section: Art. 157
location.quote: Ai sensi della L. 1° marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di assenza obbligatoria e facoltativa, la lavoratrice ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico dell'INPS, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 170.

provenance.transformation: Top up weekday national holidays and the stated weekday patron saint day during compulsory maternity leave to 100% of daily pay, net of INPS and ordinary CCNL integration; no ordinary maternity integration is inferred. Paternity has no holiday target; optional leave has a separate holiday target. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 the text does not list, is excluded (excluded_days 10-04).

location.section: Art. 157
location.quote: Ai sensi della L. 1° marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di assenza obbligatoria e facoltativa, la lavoratrice ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico dell'INPS, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 170.

provenance.transformation: Top up an indemnified optional-leave weekday holiday to the full daily CCNL pay after the INPS benefit and any ordinary CCNL top-up; include a stated local patron day. Sunday holidays receive their own quota and the unlisted 4 October remains excluded.

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, professioni digitali e STP, stesura 9 marzo 2022

location.section: Art. 147 - Injury pay
location.quote:
1) 60% (sessanta per cento) per i primi tre giorni (periodo di carenza);
2) 75% (cento per cento) per i giorni dal 4° in poi della retribuzione giornaliera netta cui il lavoratore
     avrebbe avuto diritto in caso di normale svolgimento del rapporto. Per retribuzione giornaliera si intende
     la quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 168.

provenance.transformation: The explicit numerical 75% is used rather than the contradictory parenthetical words (100%). The three days after the injury are paid at 60%; from offset 4 the INAIL benefit is topped up to 75% of net daily pay. The conflicting wording requires a clarification before a 100% target can be asserted.

source_document.title: CCNL CED, ICT, professioni digitali e STP, stesura 9 marzo 2022

location.section: Art. 149 - Festività nel periodo di malattia o infortunio
location.quote: Ai sensi della L. 31 marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di malattia o infortunio, il lavoratore ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico rispettivamente dell'INPS e dell'INAIL, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro, in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 168.

provenance.transformation: On a covered national weekday holiday during a work injury, employer integration reaches 100% of the daily pay after subtracting INAIL indemnity and the ordinary CCNL integration already due on that day; the clause also covers sickness. The stated local patron saint day is covered on weekdays.

reviews.scope: Arts. 178-181 of the 2022 agreement and the 2025 renewal, cached primary PDFs pp. 112 and 32, plus effective dates.
findings: Daily meal benefit €6 from 2022 and €8 from September 2025; transport and valuables are variable and remain a limitation; Art. 177 repealed.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 42 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 0 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 166 of the stesura of 9 March 2022 (PDF p. 106), text layer.
findings: Modelled the scatti of the staff in service on 31 December 2018 (were none).
Art. 149: the festività in a sickness or injury are topped up to 100% of the pay, net of the INPS and INAIL indemnity: sickness_rules.holiday rate 1; the injury part stays a limitation.

reviews.scope: Art. 157, PDF p. 102: holiday top-up during compulsory maternity.
findings: Verified the quoted clause against the cached PDF; encoded only the compulsory maternity holiday target.

reviews.scope: The maternity holiday clause against the encoding, by a separate model session.
findings: Confirmed the 100% target net of the INPS share on the holidays of the compulsory leave.
Recorded as limitation maternity_holiday_scope: the Sunday holidays, the patron saint and 4 October, the optional leave.

reviews.scope: Holiday pay during work injury, including the applicable holiday calendar and the offset against statutory and contractual daily pay.
findings: Covered weekday holiday target reaches full daily pay after INAIL and ordinary CCNL integration; employer-specific holidays remain outside the national calendar.

reviews.scope: Art. 147 - Injury pay, ordinary injury integration and waiting days against the cached PDF.
findings: The explicit numerical 75% is used rather than the contradictory parenthetical words (100%). The three days after the injury are paid at 60%; from offset 4 the INAIL benefit is topped up to 75% of net daily pay. The conflicting wording requires a clarification before a 100% target can be asserted.

reviews.scope: Art. 147 against the injury integration bands, by a separate model session.
findings: Confirmed the waiting days at 60%, the bands from the INAIL indemnity and the day mapping from the injury day.
Flagged, kept as limitations: the 75% of the numeral against the '(cento per cento)' in words.

reviews.scope: Local patron saint day in sickness and work injury holiday clauses.
findings: Art. 149 - Festività nel periodo di malattia o infortunio (p. 97): Ai sensi della L. 31 marzo 1954, n. 90, per le festività cadenti nel periodo di malattia o infortunio, il lavoratore ha diritto ad un'indennità integrativa di quella a carico rispettivamente dell'INPS e dell'INAIL, da corrispondersi a carico del datore di lavoro, in modo da raggiungere complessivamente il 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 168. The stated local patron saint day is covered when the target opts in; unstated days leave other holidays unchanged.

reviews.scope: Arts. 149 and 157 and the patron saint holiday list, cached 2022 PDF pp. 97 and 102.
findings: Sickness and injury already include the stated patron saint day; maternity now includes it too. Optional parental leave was outside the maternity target at the time of this review.

reviews.scope: Art. 157, cached 2022 PDF p. 102: holidays during compulsory and optional leave.
findings: The optional absence has the same daily holiday target as compulsory absence; the stated local patron is already a covered holiday.

reviews.scope: Art. 119 of the stesura of 9 March 2022 (permits, ROL ramp, deadline).
findings: The file had the ferie but no permit: added the 32 hours of ex festivita, the 56/72 hours of ROL with the ramp of the hires after 9 March 2022, and the 30 June deadline of Art. 119.
